meta.description: Process, clean, compare, and search tandem mass spectra with matchms. Provides comprehensive MS/MS file I/O, metadata harmonization, peak filtering, spectral similarity scoring, library matching, score matrices, and molecular-similarity networks. Targets matchms 0.33.1 with correct API patterns and migration guidance from older versions.

scientific_integrity.detail: Correctly warns that similarity is evidence not proof of identity; references authoritative matchms documentation and scientific publications

practice_boundaries.detail: Clear scope boundaries stating not a replacement for LC-MS feature detection, vendor conversion, or validated identification protocol

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established matchms library with proper version pinning (0.33.1) and migration guidance from deprecated APIs

code_usability.detail: Production-ready code patterns with current API, comprehensive examples, bundled CLI tool, and detailed reference documentation

functional_suitability.note: Complete coverage of MS/MS workflows: loading, processing, scoring, library search, with bundled CLI and multiple similarity methods

reliability.note: Excellent error prevention with API guardrails section, migration guide, explicit warnings about common pitfalls, and non-negotiable checks

performance_context.note: Efficient with guidance on large comparisons, sparse arrays, symmetric scoring, precursor gating, and pair-count estimation

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow, quick start, detailed API documentation; minor: could add more inline comments in complex examples

human_usability.note: Natural triggers (MS/MS, spectral matching, metabolomics), clear structure, bundled CLI with comprehensive help

security.note: Explicit pickle safety warnings, untrusted data cautions, no hardcoded credentials, local file workflows default

maintainability.note: Well-structured with 5 modular reference files, version-specific examples, deprecation tracking, and migration documentation

agent_specific.note: Good composability and scope definition; deterministic for same inputs; minor: workflow orchestration could be more explicit for multi-step pipelines

key_strengths: Comprehensive API coverage with version-specific correctness (0.33.1) and detailed migration guide from deprecated patterns
Excellent safety guidance: explicit pickle warnings, non-negotiable checks, and clear statements that similarity is not proof of identity
Production-ready workflows with bundled CLI tool, multiple similarity methods, and optimization guidance for large datasets
Strong documentation structure with 5 modular reference files covering importing, filtering, similarity, workflows, and migration
Clear scope boundaries distinguishing matchms from LC-MS feature detection, proteomics, and vendor conversion tools
